finding.mechanism: Pinned SDK Messageable.send/Message.edit register unfinished dispatchable Views in ConnectionState.ViewStore. MCS cards timeout=None therefore one View retained per delivered message; MCS already handles all component tokens through bot-wide Actions.on_interaction. Stop render-only Views before send/edit so store condition false; wire components still serialized. ConnectionState.parse_interaction_create always dispatches interaction after store dispatch, including no-match.

measurement.fixture: 1000 classic payloads against actual in-memory ViewStore; exact pinned send/edit registration condition; no connection/network
measurement.limitations: One synthetic tracemalloc trial; primary stable criterion is retained View counts, not extrapolated runtime memory saving.
